channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, AI, Tech & Research, Europe, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, AI, Tech & Research, Europe, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Leibniz Summer Fellowships 2027 (ZZF Potsdam, contemporary history)
item.description: Leibniz Centre for Contemporary History Potsdam (ZZF) · deadline 30 Nov 2026 · Two fellowships of EUR 3,000 per month for two months (EUR 6,000 total each), plus office space, computer facilities, specialist library access and participation in ZZF's academic community. No application fee.

item.title: KU Leuven AI Safety Lab: Visiting Fellowships 2027 (Leuven)
item.description: KU Leuven AI Safety Lab · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · EUR 2,000 per month for three months, covering accommodation and living costs, plus office space, library access and KU Leuven facilities. Five fellowships. No application fee.

item.title: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study Fellowships 2027/28 (Lisbon)
item.description: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study (GIAS), Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Up to 15 fellowships a year. Each covers travel costs, travel and health insurance, a monthly stipend and a partial housing subsidy; the stipend level is set at selection based on CV and length of stay. No application fee.

item.title: KHK CURE Fellowships 2027/2028, Saarland University (theme: Things)
item.description: Kaete Hamburger Centre for Cultural Practices of Reparation (CURE), Saarland University · deadline 30 Nov 2026 · Up to twelve fellowships. Fellows on unpaid leave from their institution receive approximately EUR 6,100 to 7,200 per month before taxes, depending on qualifications; alternatively, fellows retaining their salary can have their home institution reimbursed for replacement teaching. One round trip to Saarbruecken is reimbursed, a fully equipped individual workspace is provided, and an apartment can be arranged for around EUR 1,250 per month. Eligible accompanying family members may receive additional support. No application fee.

item.title: Institute for Law & AI: Winter Research Fellowship EU Law 2027 (Cambridge, UK)
item.description: Institute for Law & AI (LawAI) · deadline 12 Oct 2026 · GBP 1,000 weekly stipend for the 10-week fellowship (GBP 10,000 total), plus a GBP 7,000 relocation and housing payment. No application fee.

item.title: European Cultural Foundation: Academic Research Fellowship (ECF Historical Archives)
item.description: European Cultural Foundation, hosted at the Historical Archives of the European Union · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 grant to support a research stay at the HAEU, covering travel, accommodation and living expenses. The parallel Artistic Research Fellowship carries EUR 10,000 and additionally covers artistic production. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research fellowship - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• American Academy in Berlin: Berlin Prize Fellowship 2027-28
    https://www.americanacademy.de/apply/apply-for-a-fellowship/
    American Academy in Berlin · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Monthly stipend of USD 5,000, plus roundtrip airfare, accommodation at or near the Hans Arnhold Center, partial board, in-house library services and professional networking opportunities. Roughly two dozen fellowships awarded each year. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research fellowship - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• European Cultural Foundation: Artistic Research Fellowship (ECF Historical Archives)
    https://culturalfoundation.eu/open-calls/new-fellowship-programme-to-research-the-ecf-historical-archives/
    European Cultural Foundation · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 10,000 artistic-research grant covering travel, accommodation, and living costs; output delivered within 2 years. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research fellowship - week of 29 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Digital Democracy Centre x TrygFonden Fellowship Program 2027
    https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/forskningsenheder/samf/digitaldemocracycentre/news+folder/ddcxtrygfonden-fellowship-call-2027
    Digital Democracy Centre (University of Southern Denmark), with support from TrygFonden · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Either a salary subsidy or a stipend to help with travel and/or housing; specific benefits (financial support, access to DDC research resources, flexible working spaces, speaker series, networks) vary by agreement between the fellow, DDC, and partnering organizations. Applicants describe the posts they seek support for (flights, housing, research costs, salary compensation, stipend, etc.).

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research fellowship - week of 22 Jun 2026
item.description:
• KB Researcher-in-Residence (RiR) 2027
    https://lab.kb.nl/news/call-kb-researcher-residence-rir-2027
    KB, National Library of the Netherlands · deadline 27 Sep 2026 · Secondment at 0.5 FTE for 6 months based on your current salary, up to EUR 5,590 gross per month for a full-time-equivalent position, plus travel expenses, office facilities, and support from a research software engineer, research advisor, and collection and data specialists. No application fee.
